title: Group sessions
intro: Activities you ran with a class, and how each child did. Each note goes to the child's timeline.
empty: No sessions yet. Run a library activity with a class, or start a new session.
startHint: Choose the class and who took part. Then note how each child did.
started: Session started. Note how each child did.
notesHint: Tap how it went for each child. A short note is optional. Children you leave empty get no observation.
saved: Saved. The notes are on the children's timelines.
